title: The Lantern Fish
text: A great fish swims through the dark as if it were water, longer than a ship, pale and blind, its mouth hanging open. Before it, on a long stalk, dangles a light, warm and gold and lovely. It is the only warm thing you have seen in days.

options.label: Follow its warm light. It is the only warmth left down here.

outcomes.text: It leads you a long way, and then turns away, uninterested. You almost miss its light.

options.label: Douse your lights and let it pass, and pray it cannot smell you.

outcomes.text: Its blind eye passes very close, big as a door.

options.label: The cleverest lures it close with a lamp, and cuts off its light for the House.

outcomes.text: A lantern that never goes out, and a fish that wants it back, very badly.
